lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਅਨਿ ਤਿਤੈ ਲਗਦੀਆ ਨਹ ਖਿੰਜੋਤਾੜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit laaeean titai lagadeeaa nah khi(n)jotaaRaa ||
lines.translation: Wherever I join them, there they are joined; they do not struggle against me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਇਛੀ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾੜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo ichhee so phal paaidaa gur a(n)dar vaaRaa ||
lines.translation: I obtain the fruits of my desires; the Guru has directed me within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤੁਠਾ ਭਾਇਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਦਾ ਨੇੜਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: gur naanak tuthaa bhaairahu har vasadaa neRaa ||10||
lines.translation: When Guru Nanak is pleased, O Siblings of Destiny, the Lord is seen to be dwelling near at hand. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਮੂੰ ਆਵਹਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤੂ ਤਾ ਹਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa moo(n) aavahi chit too taa habhe sukh lahaau ||
lines.translation: When You come into my consciousness, then I obtain all peace and comfort.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮੰਝਿ ਰੰਗਾਵਲਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਤਹਿਜਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak man hee ma(n)jh ra(n)gaavalaa piree tahijaa naau ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak: with Your Name within my mind, O my Husband Lord, I am filled with delight. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਏ ਹਭੇ ਹੀ ਛਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kapaR bhog vikaar e habhe hee chhaar ||
lines.translation: Enjoyment of clothes and corrupt pleasures - all these are nothing more than dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਕੁ ਲੋੁੜੇਦਾ ਤੰਨਿ ਖੇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਦੀਦਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: khaak louRedaa ta(n)n khe jo rate deedaar ||2||
lines.translation: I long for the dust of the feet of those who are imbued with the Lord's Vision. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਤਕਹਿ ਬਿਆ ਪਾਸ ਕਰਿ ਹੀਅੜੇ ਹਿਕੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa takahi biaa paas kar heeaRe hik adhaar ||
lines.translation: Why do you look in other directions? O my heart, take the Support of the Lord alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥੀਉ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਭੀ ਸੁਖ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: theeu sa(n)tan kee ren jit labhee sukh daataar ||3||
lines.translation: Become the dust of the feet of the Saints, and find the Lord, the Giver of peace. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਲਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin karamaa har jeeu na paaeeai bin satigur manooaa na lagai ||
lines.translation: Without good karma, the Dear Lord is not found; without the True Guru, the mind is not joined to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮੁ ਧੀਰਾ ਕਲਿ ਅੰਦਰੇ ਇਹੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਤਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharam dheeraa kal a(n)dare ihu paapee mool na tagai ||
lines.translation: Only the Dharma remains stable in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga; these sinners will not last at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਅਹਿ ਕਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ahi kar kare s ahi kar paae ik ghaRee muhat na lagai ||
lines.translation: Whatever one does with this hand, he obtains with the other hand, without a moment's delay.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਜੁਗ ਮੈ ਸੋਧਿਆ ਵਿਣੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਭਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaare jug mai sodhiaa vin sa(n)gat aha(n)kaar na bhagai ||
lines.translation: I have examined the four ages, and without the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, egotism does not depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਛੁਟਈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸਤਸੰਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai mool na chhutaee vin saadhoo satasa(n)gai ||
lines.translation: Egotism is never eradicated without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਚਰੁ ਥਾਹ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਭੰਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tichar thaah na paavaee jichar saahib siu man bha(n)gai ||
lines.translation: As long as one's mind is torn away from his Lord and Master, he finds no place of rest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਘਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣੁ ਅਭਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin jan guramukh seviaa tis ghar deebaan abhagai ||
lines.translation: That humble being, who, as Gurmukh, serves the Lord, has the Support of the Imperishable Lord in the home of his heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗੈ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: har kirapaa te sukh paaiaa gur satigur charanee lagai ||11||
lines.translation: By the Lord's Grace, peace is obtained, and one is attached to the feet of the Guru, the True Guru. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋੜੀਦੋ ਹਭ ਜਾਇ ਸੋ ਮੀਰਾ ਮੀਰੰਨ ਸਿਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: loReedo habh jaai so meeraa meera(n)n sir ||
lines.translation: I have searched everywhere for the King over the heads of kings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਠ ਮੰਝਾਹੂ ਸੋ ਧਣੀ ਚਉਦੋ ਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hath ma(n)jhaahoo so dhanee chaudo mukh alaai ||1||
lines.translation: That Master is within my heart; I chant His Name with my mouth. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਿਕੂ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਉ ਡਿੰਨਾ ਧਣੀ ਅਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanikoo mohi maau di(n)naa dhanee apaahi ||
lines.translation: O my mother, the Master has blessed me with the jewel.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਆਉ ਮਹਿਜਾ ਠੰਢੜਾ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਅਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: hiaau mahijaa tha(n)dhaRaa mukhahu sach alaai ||2||
lines.translation: My heart is cooled and soothed, chanting the True Name with my mouth. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂ ਥੀਆਊ ਸੇਜ ਨੈਣਾ ਪਿਰੀ ਵਿਛਾਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: moo theeaaoo sej nainaa piree vichhaavanaa ||
lines.translation: I have become the bed for my Beloved Husband Lord; my eyes have become the sheets.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਡੇਖੈ ਹਿਕ ਵਾਰ ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਕੀਮਾ ਹੂ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: je dekhai hik vaar taa sukh keemaa hoo baahare ||3||
lines.translation: If You look at me, even for an instant, then I obtain peace beyond all price. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਲੋਚੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਣ ਕਉ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man lochai har milan kau kiu darasan paaeeaa ||
lines.translation: My mind longs to meet the Lord; how can I obtain the Blessed Vision of His Darshan?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਲਖ ਵਿੜਤੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਜੇ ਬਿੰਦ ਬੋੁਲਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai lakh viRate saahibaa je bi(n)d boulaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: I obtain hundreds of thousands, if my Lord and Master speaks to me, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੀਆ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਨ ਸਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai chaare ku(n)daa bhaaleeaa tudh jevad na saaeeaa ||
lines.translation: I have searched in four directions; there is no other as great as You, Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਦਸਿਹੁ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸੰਤਹੋ ਕਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai dasihu maarag sa(n)taho kiu prabhoo milaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: Show me the Path, O Saints. How can I meet God?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜਹੁ ਇਤੁ ਪੰਥਿ ਜੁਲਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man arapihu haumai tajahu it pa(n)th julaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: I dedicate my mind to Him, and renounce my ego. This is the Path which I shall take.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit sevihu saahib aapanaa satasa(n)g milaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I serve my Lord and Master continually.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀਆ ਗੁਰ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe aasaa pooreeaa gur mahal bulaaeeaa ||
lines.translation: All my hopes are fulfilled; the Guru has ushered me into the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੋੁਸਾਈਆ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: tudh jevad hor na sujhaee mere mitr gousaaeeaa ||12||
lines.translation: I cannot conceive of any other as great as You, O my Friend, O Lord of the World. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਡਖਣੇ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dakhane mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Dakhanay, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂ ਥੀਆਊ ਤਖਤੁ ਪਿਰੀ ਮਹਿੰਜੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: moo theeaaoo takhat piree mahi(n)je paatisaah ||
lines.translation: I have become the throne for my Beloved Lord King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਵ ਮਿਲਾਵੇ ਕੋਲਿ ਕਵਲ ਜਿਵੈ ਬਿਗਸਾਵਦੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: paav milaave kol kaval jivai bigasaavado ||1||
lines.translation: If You place Your foot on me, I blossom forth like the lotus flower. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੀਆ ਸੰਦੜੀ ਭੁਖ ਮੂ ਲਾਵਣ ਥੀ ਵਿਥਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pireeaa sa(n)daRee bhukh moo laavan thee vitharaa ||
lines.translation: If my Beloved becomes hungry, I will become food, and place myself before Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਣੁ ਮਿਠਾਈ ਇਖ ਬੇਈ ਪੀੜੇ ਨਾ ਹੁਟੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jaan mithaaee ikh beee peeRe naa hutai ||2||
lines.translation: I may be crushed, again and again, but like sugarcane, I do not stop yielding sweet juice. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਠਗਾ ਨੀਹੁ ਮਤ੍ਰੋੜਿ ਜਾਣੁ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬਾ ਨਗਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: thagaa neehu matroR jaan ga(n)dhrabaa nagaree ||
lines.translation: Break off your love with the cheaters; realize that it is a mirage.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖ ਘਟਾਊ ਡੂਇ ਇਸੁ ਪੰਧਾਣੂ ਘਰ ਘਣੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sukh ghataaoo dooi is pa(n)dhaanoo ghar ghane ||3||
lines.translation: Your pleasure lasts for only two moments; this traveller wanders through countless homes. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਨਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਲੇਖੰ ॥
lines.transliteration: akal kalaa nah paaeeai prabh alakh alekha(n) ||
lines.translation: God is not found by intellectual devices; He is unknowable and unseen.
